status: prior O4c evidence; no authenticated or viewer media request in S1
verbatim_paragraph: Full-PDF downloads invoke CAPTCHA even after authentication. The active public `showRecaptcha` function unconditionally resets/displays the CAPTCHA and creates a `/php/pdf_dump.php` POST form; its bounded account-free recording is `fixtures/anemi_download_control.js`. This continuation does not cross that gate. The ordinary View Document interface publishes `/php/pdf_split.php`, which serves a bounded PDF of selected pages. The viewer-to-filename template is verified against its actual iframe; at most three contiguous pages starting at zero-based index 2 (or the final available page for short books) are requested and decoded. Returned page count must exactly match the bound. PDFium measures each page's characters, Greek/polytonic/Cyrillic ratios using `o4c_common.metrics`, records per-page and combined measurements, and checks for a large raster object. Selected full-file pages/size remain source-declared; line estimates extrapolate the sample to that page count. A multi-volume catalogue record can list multiple PDFs: all stay in `scan_files`, and only the first offered PDF is sampled. **These are viewer-derivative PDF text-layer measurements. Original full-PDF embedded text, unsampled pages, physical-print language and scan provenance are not inferred from an empty or nonempty derivative sample.** Automatic raw PDF responses remain in memory; the explicitly recorded anonymous three-page fixture described below is the sole exception. Empty samples and unprobed documents remain distinct.
